cdp.name: CDP
cdp.gloss: Customer Data Platform — the unified store of who your customers are.

perso.name: Personalization (1:1)
perso.gloss: Tailoring the message to the individual, not the segment.

genai.name: Generative AI
genai.gloss: Models that produce content — copy, images, replies — from a prompt.

agentic.name: Agentic AI
agentic.gloss: Systems that don't just generate, they decide and act toward a goal.

decis.name: Agentic decisioning
decis.gloss: An agent choosing what to say, when, how often and on which channel — per person.

bandit.name: Bandits / RL
bandit.gloss: The maths that lets a system learn which choice wins by trying and measuring.

cep.name: CEP
cep.gloss: Customer Engagement Platform — where this messaging actually runs.

geo.name: GEO
geo.gloss: Generative Engine Optimization — being visible inside AI answers.

govern.name: Governance
govern.gloss: The controls that make automated decisions safe, explainable and legible.

stories.head: Bloomreach acquires AthenaHQ to connect AI search visibility to measurable revenue
stories.plain: Bloomreach, a major customer engagement platform, is buying AthenaHQ, a specialist in answer engine optimization. The deal signals that GEO is maturing from a tactic into a revenue-linked discipline — and that CEPs are racing to own the layer between AI-generated search results and actual purchases. Big implications for how MarTech stacks are bought and built.

stories.head: When AI agents evaluate B2B vendors, what earns consideration?
stories.plain: This piece explains how AI buying agents now shortlist B2B vendors — and what structured, credible product information you need to appear in those results. It shifts GEO from a consumer-brand concern to a B2B procurement issue, meaning how vendors present themselves online now directly affects whether an AI agent recommends them to a potential buyer.

stories.head: ReachAgents launches personal-agent advertising medium with human review built in
stories.plain: Vulture Labs' ReachAgents is building a new ad channel where sponsored content is served directly to consumers' personal AI agents, with mandatory human review of businesses and creatives before anything reaches an agent. This is an early structural model for governing agentic advertising — a space that has no established rules yet.

stories.head: Amperity's Pér AI agent demos end-to-end campaign creation from customer data gap to A/B test
stories.plain: A short demo shows Amperity's agent Pér spotting a Gen Z retention gap in live customer data, pulling creative assets from Salesforce, designing a holdout group, and drafting the campaign — without human hand-holding at each step. It is a concrete example of agentic decisioning running across a real CDP, making abstract promises visible.

stories.head: Revefi launches Closed-Loop AI FinOps to enforce enterprise AI spend at runtime
stories.plain: Revefi's new system turns AI budget approvals into hard runtime guardrails — if an LLM or agent call would breach a budget policy, it is blocked before it runs. As agentic AI spend becomes unpredictable and large, financial governance at the infrastructure level is becoming a real procurement requirement for enterprise marketing teams.

stories.head: Bloomreach acquires AthenaHQ to link AI answer-engine visibility to measurable revenue
stories.plain: Bloomreach, a major customer engagement platform, has bought AthenaHQ, whose answer-engine optimization tools track when and how brands appear inside AI-generated answers. The deal matters because it ties GEO/AEO measurement directly to revenue, giving marketers a commercial case for optimizing AI visibility rather than treating it as a vanity metric.

stories.head: When AI agents evaluate B2B vendors, what earns consideration?
stories.plain: As AI agents increasingly shortlist B2B vendors before a human buyer ever clicks, this piece examines what signals — clear product data, third-party evidence, structured content — actually move a brand onto an agent's recommendation list. It reframes generative engine optimization as a buying-process problem, not just an SEO problem.

stories.head: Amperity Pér AI agent finds retention gap, pulls creative, sets A/B test, and drafts campaign autonomously
stories.plain: A live demo shows Amperity's Pér agentic AI working end-to-end: it spots a Gen Z retention problem in customer data, retrieves creative assets from Salesforce, configures a holdout and A/B test, and writes the campaign brief — without human handoffs. This is a concrete example of agentic decisioning over a CDP reaching production.

stories.head: Marketing ops must fix disconnected data before AI agents make brand-breaking promises
stories.plain: AI agents acting on incomplete customer data will make commitments the brand can't keep — a governance risk hiding inside an infrastructure problem. The article argues marketing ops owns agent readiness and must connect data pipelines now, before agentic workflows scale errors into customer-facing failures.

stories.head: AI-native CRM Dreamteam raises $53M to replace static pipelines with AI coworkers
stories.plain: Dreamteam has closed a $53M round to build a CRM that learns continuously from every customer conversation and uses specialized AI teammates to proactively advance deals. The funding signals serious venture conviction that agentic, learning CRM can displace Salesforce-era incumbents — changing what buyers expect from the category.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: AI Agents Are Rewriting the Purchase Funnel
body: AI agents are increasingly making or heavily influencing vendor shortlists before a human buyer ever clicks. This means being findable by an algorithm, not just a person, is now a core demand-generation requirement — a shift that upends decades of SEO and content strategy.

Bloomreach's acquisition of AthenaHQ signals that Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) is moving from experiment to boardroom priority. Brands that cannot surface credibly inside AI-generated answers risk being invisible to an entire class of automated buyers & discovery engines.
ev: Agile Brand · Sitecore on winning shortlist before first click

themes.head: Agentic Infrastructure Becomes the New Martech Stack
body: Multiple signals this month show that marketers are deploying AI agents faster than the governance & measurement frameworks exist to manage them. Marketing ops teams are being pushed to build agent-readiness playbooks — data hygiene, process documentation, and brand guardrails — before autonomous systems make costly errors at scale.

Products like Optimizely's brand-process layer and ReachAgents' human-review loop reflect a new design pattern: agents need structured guardrails baked in at the infrastructure level, not bolted on afterward. This repositions marketing ops from a support function to the team that determines whether AI adoption actually sticks.

MarTech · Building workflows around AI agents

themes.head: Who Owns Customer Relationships When AI Takes the Order?
body: As AI handles more transactional touchpoints — taking orders, resolving disputes, recommending products — brands face a structural question: the relationship layer is migrating away from humans on both sides of the transaction. Consumers are already using AI to dispute charges and recover fees, effectively putting a bot between themselves and the brand.

This month's coverage converges on a warning: CX is now marketing's accountability, not just a service function. If marketers do not architect the emotional & relational signals inside AI-mediated journeys, brand loyalty becomes a residue rather than a managed asset.
ev: MarTech · AI agents make CX marketing's problem
Agile Brand · AI takes the order, who keeps the customer
Agile Brand · Consumers use AI to recover money

themes.head: Measurement & Attribution Hit a Structural Wall
body: Three separate pieces this month tackle the same underlying crisis: legacy attribution models were not designed for AI-mediated, multi-agent media environments. Marketers are deploying AI-driven campaigns while still relying on last-click or single-channel metrics that cannot capture how agents influence decisions upstream.

The emerging answer is a hybrid layer — combining Marketing Mix Modelling with post-purchase survey data & cross-channel frameworks — but adoption is lagging deployment speed. The practical risk is that cheap CAC metrics mask expensive downstream churn, locking teams into growth strategies that look efficient on dashboards but erode lifetime value.
ev: MarTech · Deploying agents faster than measuring them
MarTech · Cross-channel measurement for AI-first media
MarTech · Combining MMM with post-purchase survey attribution

themes.head: AI Cost Governance Emerges as a Strategic Constraint
body: With AI tooling now embedded across martech stacks, uncontrolled compute & data costs are surfacing as a material budget risk. New entrants like Revefi (AI FinOps) and Seemore Data (cutting Snowflake & Databricks costs by 33%) signal that cost governance is graduating from an IT concern to a CMO-level conversation.

This matters strategically because unchecked AI spend can cannibalize the performance gains AI is supposed to deliver. Marketing leaders who treat infrastructure economics as someone else's problem will find their AI ROI story undermined before they can prove it to the CFO.
ev: MarTech Series · Revefi closed-loop AI FinOps

month.takeaway: Across every layer of the stack this month, the defining tension is the same: AI is moving faster than the governance, measurement, and relationship models marketers need to control it — and the teams that close that gap first will own the next competitive cycle.
